feedback.end: Horses are strong mammals. Humans have been using horses for around 6,000 years!
Horses are herbivores, which means they only eat plants. They have flat teeth to help them grind and chew plants.
Horses are very useful! They can pull heavy loads for long distances without getting tired. Before we had cars, riding on a horse was also the fastest way to get around.

instruction.text: Select the correct part of the horse.

feedback.end: Horses have four hooves, which need to be trimmed, just like our nails.
Horses have manes, which protect them from flies, the cold and the rain.
Horses use their tails to swat away insects.
Some horses have natural markings on their heads. Each marking is unique to the horse.
